manifestations.description: pain and deformity over right wrist
pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead
easier tiredness of the hand, and needed more frequent breaks during prolonged writing and drawing
swollen area around right eye (described as a 'black eye' of around 3 inches in diameter) which subsided after 2 to 3 weeks
teased by classmates due to swollen face; felt embarrassed and distressed
bruising over right leg, swelling over left knee, and pain over right angle of jaw, left posterior pelvis and both shoulders

treatments_received.treatment: admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH) for treatment
source: Immediately after the Accident, she was admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department (“A&E”) of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (“TKOH”) for treatment.

treatments_received.treatment: admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH and put on a long arm cast for treatment of the fracture of the right wrist
source: She was admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH for further management, and was put on a long arm cast for treatment of the fracture of the right wrist.

treatments_received.treatment: long arm cast trimmed to a short arm cast on 13 October 2010
source: The long arm cast was trimmed to a short arm cast on 13 October 2010.
It was further removed on 3 November 2010.

treatments_received.treatment: referred for regular follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH)
source: She was discharged from TKOH on 28 September 2010, and was referred for regular follow-up treatments at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (“PWH”) on 29 September 2010.

treatments_received.treatment: treatment at the A&E of TKOH (Ma Kwan Tung and Chan Mei Ling)
